title: Director at Systems Integrator Sees CrowdStrike-Related Business Growing 15%–20% in 2026, With SIEM and Falcon Flex Driving Expansion
expert: Director at a global systems integrator, cyber transformation for 20+ active CrowdStrike accounts (EMEA/Middle East)
verdict: An SI director across 20+ active CrowdStrike accounts saw CrowdStrike-related business accelerate to 18%-22% y/y in Aug-Oct from 15%-20% the prior quarter, on SIEM displacement and larger Flex deals.

Flex utilization / re-Flex cadence: 60%-70% year-one pool use vs SB #59367 [14 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268792&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse28706&hl=fse28706,fse28985,fse29157,fse29426,fse29538,fse29628&page=2)
NG-SIEM displacement pace: Two, three points share gain [9 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268792&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse39213&hl=fse39213,fse39264,fse39359,fse39582,fse39764,fse40029,fse40204&page=2)

changes: Inflection: 18%-22% y/y vs 15%-20% prior quarter; below Cleveland 30%+ (SB #43076)

<10% paying for AI security vs AIDR ~3x q/q (SB #47033): conflicting

new_datapoints.text: SI's CrowdStrike-related business +18%-22% y/y (+4%-6% q/q) in Aug-Oct 2026 vs +15%-20% prior quarter
SI closed six to nine CrowdStrike deals in Aug-Oct 2026 vs five to seven expected
New implementation size $500,000-$1.2 million vs $500,000-$1 million; average deal size +20%-25% y/y
Flex credit-based deals $600,000-$1.1 million vs $300,000-$700,000 non-Flex; Flex accounts 5-7 modules vs 3-4
Some clients use only 60%-70% of year-one Falcon Flex pools; 15%-25% of Flex accounts spend credits on AI
SIEM 1/3 of SI's CrowdStrike pipeline value (Nov-26) vs 1/5 six months earlier
CrowdStrike discounts typically 10%-15%, up to 20% vs Microsoft/Palo Alto; renewal uplift 5%-10%; effective unit pricing flat to +5%
Fewer than 10% of customers pay for dedicated AI security; AI demand 20%-25% of pipeline
SI forecasts CrowdStrike business +15%-20% Nov-Jan, +15%-20% FY2026 (vs 12%-15% plan), +12%-18% FY2027
CrowdStrike gained two, three points share in endpoint/SecOps in Aug-Oct 2026 from legacy, SentinelOne, Splunk
Falcon SIEM ingestion 30%-50% cheaper than Splunk and 20%-35% cheaper than Microsoft Sentinel
SentinelOne typical discounts 25%-35%; CrowdStrike 15%-25% pricier than SentinelOne
